# Rocket 4 Plus SSD

 

5 YEARS STANDARD WARRANTY

5-year warranty. No registration required.

View Warranty Policy →

### Product Highlights

 Gen4 Speed — Supreme PCIe ® Gen4 technology for your PC or laptop for heavy-duty applications in gaming, graphics, data analytics, and more 

 Free Acronis — All Sabrent SSDs come with Sabrent Acronis True Image for Sabrent, a free and simple to use cloning software 

 Unmatched Reliability — Power consumption is much lower than traditional hard drives, making it the best-embedded solution for new systems 

 High Capacity — Whatever your needs are (high-res photos, videos, sound files, etc.), we have you covered with 500GB of storage 

 Free shipping 5-8 business days 

 Customer Support Mon-Fri 9:00 - 17:00 EST 

 

 Extended Warranty Up to 5 Years 

 Specs 

- PCIe 4.0 x4 interface, NVMe 1.3 compliant. APST/ASPM/L1.2 support.
- Supports SMART and TRIM functions. Works in an enclosure.
- Wide flash compatibility. Uses TLC with DRAM.
- Advanced endurance features for a long drive lifespan.
- Upgradeable firmware and software support.
- 4.0-capable motherboard and M.2 heatsink are recommended, but the drive is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0 and 2.0 M.2 sockets.

 Dimensions 

Length: 3.15 in. Width: 0.86 in. Height: 0.11 in. Weight: 0.2 oz.

 In the box 

- M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 NVMe TLC SSD User manual

 Manuals 

 SB-RKT4P-XXX - User Manual [English] English SB-RKT4P-XXX - Firmware Upgrade Manual English

...

## FAQ

Is this drive compatible with my system?

You must have a motherboard with an available M.2 socket that supports a NVMe drive. It may be possible to use an enclosure or adapter, but NVMe boot support on older systems is not guaranteed. This drive is backward compatible with PCIe 3.0 and 2.0 even with fewer than four lanes, but will be bandwidth-limited.

What is the warranty for this drive?

1 year or 5 years with registration. Endurance is rated at 350TBW for the 500GB SKU.

What's the hardware on the SSD?

This drive utilizes Phison's E18 controller with DRAM, along with 96-layer or newer TLC.

# rocket 5

 

ROCKET 5 

You’re ready for something new. 

 

 

OUR FASTEST SSD EVER 

Take your storage performance to the next level with the Sabrent Rocket 5, the natural successor to our award-winning Rocket 4 Plus and gaming-inspired Rocket 4 Plus-G. This fresh hardware uses the latest storage technology to reach all-new heights. 

 

WITH BIG SPEED COMES BIG CAPACITY 

Available at up to 4TB at launch and later 8TB, you will be able to transfer lots of data fast and never run out of space. Put your favorite games, applications, and often-accessed files on the most capable storage possible with the Rocket 5. 

2 

 

Never Get Left Behind 

Enjoy transfers at up to an astounding 14GB/s or more, making the best use of PCIe 5.0 bandwidth. The DirectStorage-optimized firmware also makes sure you’re always at the top of your game, backed by ample DRAM, the newest NAND flash, and a powerful eight-channel controller. 

3
